tools.name: migrate_otter_version
tools.description:
Use this tool to help users migrate their Otter project to a newer version.

**Workflow:**
1. Call this tool to get the current Otter version from the user's `package.json`
2. If no target version is specified, call `get_supported_releases_amadeusitgroup/otter` to fetch available releases
3. Compare the current version with available releases to identify newer versions
4. Present the newer versions to the user and ask which one they want to migrate to
5. Call this tool again with the target version to get migration instructions

packageJsonPath.description: Absolute path to the package.json file in the user's project. Defaults to './package.json' if not provided.

targetVersion.description: The target Otter version to migrate to (e.g., "11.0", "12.0", "13.0"). If not provided, the tool will list available versions.

tools.name: angular_schematics
tools.description: List Angular schematics (ng generate) and their basic options.

tools.name: get_best_practices
tools.description:
A comprehensive guide detailing Otter's best practices for code generation and development.
This guide should be used as a reference by an LLM to ensure any generated code adheres to modern Otter and Angular standards.

tools.name: create_monorepo_with_app
tools.description:
You **MUST** use this tool to create a monorepo with an application inside.
It is mandatory to follow this guide to ensure all code adheres to Otter standards. This is the first step for any Otter repository.

repositoryName.description: The name of the repository to create.

applicationName.description: The name of the application to create inside the monorepo.
